title: narbacular-drop
about: Wait for the main menu and choose Quit: the game writes system.opt beside its exe (two flags and the two volumes, 20 bytes) and exits. The game's cursor follows the mouse at about 1.25 x and 0.95 y, more for fast motion: a move of (-1500, -1500) puts it in the top left corner, then a slow move to Quit.
